subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 3(1)/(3) years at 15% p.a. is Rs. 1,840 less than the simple interest on the same sum for 5(1)/(2) years at 12% p.a. The sum is:
solution:
**Concept used:**

S.I = PTR/100

P = Principal

T = time 

R = rate

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be Rs. 100x

According to the question,

(100x × 12 × 11)(100 × 2) - (100x × 15 × 10)/(100 × 3) = 1840

⇒ 66x - 50x = 1840

⇒ 16x = 1840

⇒ x = 1840/16

⇒ x = 115

So, sum = 100 × 115 = 11500

**∴ The sum is Rs. 11500**
